metadata.name: CORE — Root discovery and lifecycle documentation
metadata.decision: Option A. Preliminaries stay in docs/vexarq/preliminary/. Promoted documents live in the lifecycle directory. docs/vexarq/current/INDEX.md is the pointer map. Readers resolve the lifecycle path first, then the legacy docs/vexarq/current/ path.

descubrimiento.regla: Identify every affected project root. Do not assume the working directory is the root.
descubrimiento.evidencia: .git, package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, turbo.json, nx.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, pom.xml, build.gradle, Cargo.toml, go.mod, a solution or csproj, composer.json, Dockerfile, docker-compose, Terraform, Helm, src/, tests/, CI files.
descubrimiento.clases: single frontend, single backend, monolith, monorepo, multiple repositories, shared library, infrastructure repository.
descubrimiento.regla: Each repository root keeps its own docs/. A shared index exists only when a real coordinating root exists.
A monorepo uses one docs/ at the repository root unless a package is independently owned and deployed.
Never write consumer project documents inside .ai-vexarq/.

estructura.directorio: SRS, backlog, scope, constraints, risks, deployment planning.
SAD, ADRs, data and API models. Diagrams in docs/design/diagrams/.
Implementation documents, fix register, refactoring, closure. Runbooks in docs/development/operations/.
Test strategy, cases, pipeline artifacts, and test evidence.
Findings, observations, acceptance, and QA closure. Reference quality evidence. Do not copy it.
estructura.regla: Create docs/ only when it is absent. Create a subdirectory only when an artifact needs it. Do not create empty directories.
Do not add a new top-level lifecycle folder for a new document type.

fila.artefacto: SRS, requirements, backlog, extended backlog, scope
SAD, ADR, data and API models

resolucion.regla: A phase reads the promoted path in the lifecycle directory.
If that file does not exist, read the legacy file under docs/vexarq/current/.
docs/vexarq/current/INDEX.md lists id, lifecycle path, legacy path, and status. It is not a second copy of the document.
Migration of an existing consumer project uses git mv, one authoritative copy, and asks before moving.

metadatos.campo: id, title, purpose, status, version, date, scope, owner when known, depends_on, provenance summary.
metadatos.regla: Before creating a document, inspect what exists and update the authoritative file when that is enough.
Do not create a document only because a template exists. A trivial fix does not create an estimate or a diagram.

indice.contenido: Directory purpose, authoritative documents, status, conventions, and detected roots.
